message:
So `XSLT_PARSE_OPTIONS` includes `XML_PARSE_NOENT`. But in the fuzz target `xsltFuzzXslt`, the stylesheet is parsed with `xmlReadMemory(data, size, NULL, NULL, 0)` - with options `0`, NOT `XSLT_PARSE_OPTIONS`. This means `XML_PARSE_NOENT` is NOT set, so entity nodes remain in the tree.

Let me look at `xsltParseStylesheetUser` to understand how the stylesheet is processed:

<｜｜DSML｜｜ode>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libxslt && sed -n '6576,6650p' libxslt/xslt.c</｜｜DSML｜｜parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜unction>
